title: bridge_envelope
description: What the bridge writes beside the copy of a hand-over card in the receiver's inbox/<thread>/ (meta_agent/tasks/031; SMA's envelope, docs/reference/sma_read_20261108.md 6). It authors nothing: numbers is empty, author is bridge, the payload is the producer's file byte for byte and its hash is stated here. A card crosses only on the person's word (the person, 2026-11-20, 'Only on my word'). A session may run the tool on the person's word for that crossing, and the envelope then says so and quotes the words (the person, 2026-11-20, 'Yes, on my word (Recommended)'; tasks/032, bridge-2). On the hub's trigger (meta_agent/tasks/033; the person, 2026-11-20, 'Assign freely, carry on my word (Recommended)') it carries an assignment from a hub to one of its members, or a result from a member to its hub, and never a hand-over between two members.

file.description: the copy's file name beside this envelope

origin.description: the producer's file, relative to the producing bundle (outbox/<name>.json, or assignments/<name>.json for a hub)

trigger.description: human: the person's word, for any card; hub: the hub's run, for an assignment or a result only (check 25)

released_by.description: human with trigger human, hub with trigger hub

words.description: the person's words to that session for this crossing, verbatim

session.description: the hub's session, by the id or the name it is known by
